pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.2: tena kho pana samayena thullanandā bhikkhunī aññatarassa kulassa kulūpikā hoti niccabhattikā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.3: tena ca gahapatinā therā bhikkhū nimantitā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.4: atha kho thullanandā bhikkhunī pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena taṃ kulaṃ tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.5: kimidaṃ gahapati pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyattanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.8: ayyo sāriputto ayyo mahāmoggallāno ayyo mahākaccāno ayyo mahākoṭṭhito ayyo mahākappino ayyo mahācundo ayyo anuruddho ayyo revato ayyo upāli ayyo ānando ayyo rāhuloti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.9: kiṃ pana tvaṃ gahapati mahānāge tiṭṭhamāne ceṭake nimantesīti”
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.11: ayyo devadatto ayyo kokāliko ayyo kaṭamorakatissako ayyo khaṇḍadeviyā putto ayyo samuddadattoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.12: ayaṃ carahi thullanandāya bhikkhuniyā antarā kathā vippakatā. atha therā bhikkhū pavisiṃsu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.14: idāneva kho tvaṃ ayye ceṭake akāsi idāni mahānāgeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.16: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.17: “kathaṃ hi nāma devadatto jānaṃ bhikkhuni paripācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.18: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ devadatta jānaṃ bhikkhunīparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjasīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.21: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa jānaṃ bhikkhunī paripācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjissasi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.23: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.24.1: “yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ bhikkhunī paripācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:1.25: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu rājagahā pabbajito ñātikulaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.2: manussā cirassampi bhadanto āgatoti sakkaccaṃ bhattaṃ akaṃsu
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.3: tassa kulassa kulūpikā bhikkhunī te manusse etadavoca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.6: bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ jānaṃ bhikkhunī paripācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjitunti. kukkuccāyanto na paṭiggahesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.8: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.10: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.11: “anujānāmi bhikkhave pubbe gihīsamārambhe jānaṃ bhikkhunīparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjituṃ”
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.12: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:2.13.1: “yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ bhikkhunīparipācitaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ bhuñjeyya aññatra pubbe gihīsamārambhā pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:3.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti sā vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:3.1.10: pubbe adātukāmānaṃ akattukāmānaṃ ayyo bhāṇako ayyo bahussuto ayyo suttantiko ayyo vinayadharo ayyo dhammakathiko detha ayyassa karotha ayyassāti esā paripāceti nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:3.1.16: ñātakā vā honti pavāritā vā pakatipaṭiyattaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:3.1.17: aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā bhuñjissāmīti patigaṇhāti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:3.2.1: paripācite paripācitasaññī bhuñjati aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:3.2.2: paripācite vematiko bhuñjati aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:3.2.3: paripācite aparipācitasaññī bhuñjati aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā anāpatti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc29:3.2.4: ekato upasampannāya paripācitaṃ bhuñjati aññatra pubbe gihisamārambhā āpatti dukkaṭassa.
